component.name: xl-Screenshot
component.summary: Take a screenshot of the screen, a window, or a selection

description.p: xl-Screenshot is a screenshot tool for Linux Mint and the Cinnamon desktop, with a simple window that follows the system theme.

ul.li: Window: click a window to capture it with its titlebar
Selection: draw an area over a still picture of the desktop, and adjust it with handles

description.p: A delay of up to 11 seconds gives you time to open a menu first. Captures can be copied, saved as PNG, JPEG, or WebP, or marked up in xl-Annotate. An optional tray icon starts a selection with one click.

ul.li: Works on Cinnamon's Wayland session, through Cinnamon's own screenshot service
Screens: every monitor; Screen: just the one you're on (with several monitors)
Window capture picks windows like Cinnamon's picker, with clean rounded corners and an optional shadow
Fast Selection: the capture is taken as soon as you let go (Accurate Selection keeps the handles and buttons)
Selection is tinted with the theme's selection color
The delay goes up to 11 seconds
The Selection panel shows the selection's size in pixels
The first time it's used, xl-Screenshot offers to stay in the system tray
Selection, Screen and pointer captures work on HiDPI screens at 200% scaling
xl-Annotate gained curved arrows, an ink pen, Resize, Rotate & Flip and exact crop sizes
A Russian translation; all translations are drafts awaiting review

description.p: The About window links to the project page.
